name: Single Combat
oracle_text: Each player chooses a creature or planeswalker they control, then sacrifices the rest. Players can't cast creature or planeswalker spells until the end of your next turn.
blocked_sentences: Players can't cast creature or planeswalker spells until the end of your next turn.

needs.what: a one-shot, timed casting prohibition installed by a resolving spell that applies to every player and only to spells matching a spell filter (here any_types Creature or Planeswalker), with a duration lasting until the end of the caster's next turn (through that turn's cleanup, not ending as it begins)
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The cant_cast_spells op takes only player and duration and is a total lock over every castable zone, with no affects_spells filter; its durations are only this_turn and until_your_next_turn (structs.CAST_LOCK_DURATIONS), and until_your_next_turn ends as the next turn begins rather than at its end. The cant_cast_spells static does take affects_spells but lasts only while a permanent carries it, and a sorcery has none.
